description: Comprehensive user story database for Library→DAW flow and related epics. Used for UAT testing panel and E2E test generation.

epics.title: Library → DAW Navigation
epics.description: User discovers a track in the library and opens it for editing in the DAW

epics.title: DAW Multi-Track Import
epics.description: User imports multiple tracks at once from library, crate, or playlist into a DAW project

epics.title: Crate → DAW
epics.description: User moves tracks from a Crate Digger playlist into a DAW project

epics.title: DAW Project Management
epics.description: User creates, switches, and manages multiple DAW projects

epics.title: Track Classification & Metadata
epics.description: Track types are classified automatically and overridable by the user

epics.title: Cross-Feature Navigation
epics.description: User moves between Library, DJ, Crate, and DAW without losing state

stories.title: Edit downloaded track in DAW from library row
stories.goal: click 'Edit in DAW' on a downloaded track row in the library
stories.outcome: the DAW opens with that track auto-loaded in a project
preconditions: User has 0 or more existing DAW projects
steps: User navigates to /tracks or dashboard tracks tab
User sees track list with title, artist, BPM, duration columns
User hovers or right-clicks a downloaded track row
'Edit in DAW' button/action appears
User clicks 'Edit in DAW'
Browser navigates to /daw/:track_id
DAW auto-creates or opens existing project
Track appears in DAW project track list at position 0
Flash message: 'Track added to project'
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a downloaded track in the library WHEN user clicks 'Edit in DAW' THEN navigates to /daw with DAW showing that track
GIVEN user has no projects WHEN opening track in DAW THEN a new project is auto-created named after the track
GIVEN user has an existing project WHEN opening track in DAW THEN track is added to that project (or user is prompted)
GIVEN track is already in the project WHEN opening same track in DAW THEN DAW opens without duplicating the track
GIVEN DAW page loads with track_id param THEN track appears in the track list within 2 seconds

stories.title: Edit in DAW — first time (no existing project)
stories.goal: open my first track in DAW as a new user with no projects
stories.outcome: a new project is auto-created and the track is loaded
steps: User clicks 'Edit in DAW' on any downloaded track
System creates new DAW project titled '[Track Title] — Project'
Track is added at position 0
DAW renders with the new project selected in the sidebar
Track is visible in the track list
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN no existing projects WHEN track opened in DAW THEN projects sidebar shows 1 new project
GIVEN new auto-created project THEN project title contains the track's title
GIVEN new project THEN track appears at position 1 (index 0)

stories.title: Edit in DAW — existing project (auto-add)
stories.goal: open a track in DAW when I already have one project
stories.outcome: track is added to my existing project
preconditions: Track is NOT already in the project
steps: User clicks 'Edit in DAW' on a downloaded track
System identifies user's single existing project
Track is appended to the project
DAW renders with existing project + new track
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN 1 existing project WHEN track opened in DAW THEN project track count increases by 1
GIVEN added track THEN it appears at the end of the track list
GIVEN added track THEN flash shows 'Track added to [Project Name]'

stories.title: Edit in DAW — track already in project (dedup)
stories.goal: open a track in DAW that is already in my project
stories.outcome: DAW opens showing the project without duplicating the track
preconditions: User has a DAW project containing the target track
steps: User clicks 'Edit in DAW' on a track already in their project
System detects the track is already present
DAW opens without adding a duplicate
Flash: 'Track already in project'
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN track already in project WHEN opened in DAW THEN track count does NOT increase
GIVEN dedup scenario THEN no duplicate track entry appears

stories.title: Edit Spotify-only track in DAW shows download prompt
stories.goal: open a Spotify-only (not downloaded) track in DAW
stories.outcome: I see a prompt to download the track first, or the DAW informs me it can't load without a local file
preconditions: Track exists in library but has NOT been downloaded (no local file)
steps: User clicks 'Edit in DAW' on a Spotify-only track
System detects track has no local audio file
User sees: 'This track must be downloaded before editing in DAW. Download now?'
User clicks Download
Download job queued
After download completes, track auto-loads in DAW
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN Spotify-only track WHEN opened in DAW THEN download prompt shown
GIVEN download prompt THEN 'Download Now' and 'Cancel' buttons present
GIVEN user cancels THEN no DAW project created

stories.title: Edit in DAW from Sample Library (/samples)
stories.goal: open a sample in the DAW from the Sample Library view
stories.outcome: the DAW opens with that sample as a track
steps: User browses sample library at /samples
User sees 'Edit in DAW' icon/button on sample row
User clicks it
Navigates to /daw with sample loaded
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN sample in library WHEN 'Edit in DAW' clicked THEN navigates to /daw with sample loaded

stories.title: Select multiple tracks from library for DAW import
stories.goal: select 3 tracks in the DAW import panel and add them all at once
stories.outcome: all 3 tracks are added to my project in one batch operation
preconditions: User is in DAW view with a project open
Import panel is open on Library tab
steps: User opens import panel via '+ Add Track' button
Panel shows Library tab with track list and checkboxes
User clicks track row 1 → row highlights, checkbox checked
User clicks track row 2 → also selected
User clicks track row 3 → also selected
Footer shows '3 selected'
User clicks 'Add 3 Tracks'
All 3 tracks appear in project, panel closes
Flash: 'Added 3 track(s)'
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN 3 tracks selected WHEN 'Add 3 Tracks' clicked THEN project track count increases by 3
GIVEN mixed selection WHEN adding THEN only selected tracks are added
GIVEN 0 tracks selected THEN 'Add Tracks' button is disabled
GIVEN successful batch add THEN panel closes and flash shows count

stories.title: Select All tracks from library
stories.goal: click 'Select all' to select every track in the filtered library view
stories.outcome: all visible tracks are selected and the count is reflected in the footer
preconditions: Import panel open on Library tab
steps: User opens import panel
Clicks 'Select all' in footer
All track rows show checked checkboxes
Footer shows 'N selected' where N = total visible tracks
User can then click 'Add N Tracks'
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN 'Select all' clicked THEN all visible track rows are selected
GIVEN search filter active THEN 'Select all' selects only filtered results
GIVEN 'Clear' clicked after select all THEN all deselected

stories.title: Search and select filtered subset
stories.goal: search for 'Kendrick' in the import panel and select all matching tracks
stories.outcome: only the Kendrick tracks are added to my project
preconditions: Library has tracks matching search term
steps: User opens import panel
Types 'Kendrick' in search bar
Track list filters to matching results
User clicks 'Select all'
Clicks 'Add N Tracks'
Only Kendrick tracks appear in project
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN search active THEN select all only selects filtered tracks
GIVEN batch add from filtered THEN project gets only those tracks

stories.title: Browse and select specific tracks from a Crate for DAW import
stories.goal: open a crate in the import panel and select specific tracks (not the whole crate)
stories.outcome: only the selected crate tracks are added to my DAW project
preconditions: User has at least one Crate in Crate Digger
Crate has at least 2 downloaded tracks in library
steps: User opens import panel via 'Import from Crate' button or '+ Add Track' → Crate tab
Panel shows Crate tab with list of user's crates
User clicks a crate name
Panel drills into crate: shows only that crate's downloaded tracks with checkboxes
Breadcrumb shows: Crates / [Crate Name]
User selects specific tracks (not all)
Clicks 'Add N Tracks'
Only selected tracks added to project
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN crate selected in import panel THEN only tracks from that crate are shown
GIVEN partial selection from crate THEN only selected tracks added
GIVEN 'Back to Crates' clicked THEN returns to crate list
GIVEN crate has no downloaded tracks THEN message: 'No downloaded tracks from this crate'

stories.title: Import entire crate to DAW
stories.goal: click 'Select all' when browsing a crate and add every track
stories.outcome: all downloaded tracks from the crate are in my project
preconditions: User has a Crate with multiple downloaded tracks
steps: User opens import panel → Crate tab
Clicks a crate
Clicks 'Select all'
Clicks 'Add N Tracks'
All crate tracks added to project
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN crate with 5 tracks WHEN select all + add THEN project gains 5 tracks
GIVEN duplicate check WHEN track already in project THEN skipped (not duplicated)

stories.title: Edit in DAW from CrateDigger track panel
stories.goal: open a specific track from CrateDigger's slide panel directly in the DAW
stories.outcome: navigates to DAW with that track loaded
preconditions: A track is selected/open in the side panel
steps: User is on /crate with a track's side panel open
User sees 'Edit in DAW' button in the track panel
Clicks it
Navigates to /daw/:track_id
Track auto-loads in project
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN CrateDigger track panel WHEN 'Edit in DAW' clicked THEN navigates to /daw with track loaded

stories.title: Create a new DAW project
stories.goal: click '+ New Project' in the DAW sidebar
stories.outcome: a new empty project is created and selected
steps: User clicks '+ New Project' in left sidebar
New project 'Untitled Project' appears in project list
Main area shows empty state: 'No tracks yet'
Project is selected (highlighted) in sidebar
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN '+ New Project' clicked THEN project list gains 1 entry
GIVEN new project THEN title is 'Untitled Project' by default
GIVEN new project THEN 0 tracks initially

stories.title: Switch between DAW projects
stories.goal: click a different project in the sidebar
stories.outcome: the main content area switches to show that project's tracks
steps: User is on /daw with Project A selected
User clicks Project B in the sidebar
Main area updates to show Project B's tracks
Project B is highlighted in sidebar
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN 2 projects WHEN project B clicked THEN track list shows B's tracks
GIVEN project switch THEN track count badge in sidebar is correct

stories.title: Edit DAW project title inline
stories.goal: click the title field and rename my project
stories.outcome: project title is updated in the sidebar and in the DB
preconditions: User has an active DAW project
steps: User clicks the Title input in the project settings area
Types new name, presses Tab or clicks away
Sidebar updates to show new name
Page reload preserves new name
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN title input blur event THEN project title saved
GIVEN page refresh after rename THEN new title persists

stories.title: Remove track from DAW project
stories.goal: remove a track from my project using the × button
stories.outcome: track is removed from the project track list
preconditions: User has a project with at least 1 track
steps: User hovers a track row
× remove button appears (opacity-0 → opacity-100)
User clicks ×
Confirmation dialog: 'Remove this track from the project?'
User confirms
Track removed, track count decreases by 1
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN hover on track row THEN × button becomes visible
GIVEN × clicked AND confirmed THEN track removed
GIVEN × clicked AND cancelled THEN track remains

stories.title: Auto-classify track type after adding
stories.goal: add a track to DAW and have it auto-classified
stories.outcome: track shows a type badge (Full Track, Loop, Drum Loop) after classification job runs
preconditions: User has added a track to DAW project
steps: Track is added to project with type 'unknown'
Oban background job DawClassifyWorker queued
After job runs, track type badge updates
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN track added THEN DawClassifyWorker job is enqueued
GIVEN classification complete THEN track type badge is not 'Unknown'

stories.title: Manually override track type
stories.goal: click a track's type badge to change it manually
stories.outcome: track type is updated and locked with a padlock icon
preconditions: Track in project has a type badge
steps: User clicks the type badge on a track row
Inline dropdown appears with type options
User selects 'Loop'
Badge updates to 'Loop' with a padlock icon
Dropdown disappears
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN non-manual track WHEN badge clicked THEN dropdown shown
GIVEN type selected THEN badge updates immediately
GIVEN manual override THEN padlock icon appears on badge
GIVEN manual override THEN clicking badge has no effect (locked)

stories.title: Navigate back to library from DAW without losing project
stories.goal: navigate away from DAW to the library and back
stories.outcome: my DAW project and tracks are still there when I return
preconditions: User has a DAW project with tracks
steps: User is on /daw with project open
User clicks 'Library' nav tab
User sees the library track list
User clicks 'DAW' nav tab
DAW re-loads with same project active
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN project with 3 tracks WHEN navigate away + back THEN still shows 3 tracks
GIVEN navigation THEN no data loss (projects saved in DB)

stories.title: Unauthenticated user redirected to login when accessing DAW
stories.goal: access /daw without being logged in
stories.outcome: redirected to login page, then back to DAW after login
steps: User navigates to /daw directly
System detects no session
Redirect to /users/log_in
User logs in
Redirected back to /daw
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN no session WHEN accessing /daw THEN redirect to /users/log_in
GIVEN login THEN redirect to originally requested URL

stories.title: Import panel search filters track list
stories.goal: type a search query in the import panel search bar
stories.outcome: track list filters in real-time to matching titles/artists
preconditions: Import panel open on Library tab
steps: User opens import panel
Types 'Diamonds' in search bar
After 300ms debounce, track list shows only matching tracks
Selection is cleared when search changes
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN search input THEN list filters after 300ms debounce
GIVEN search with no matches THEN 'No results for ...' message shown
GIVEN empty search THEN full library shown

stories.title: Switch between Library and Crate tabs in import panel
stories.goal: click the 'Crate' tab in the import panel while on the Library tab
stories.outcome: panel switches to show crate list, selection is reset
steps: User has 2 tracks selected on Library tab
Clicks 'Crate' tab
Selection clears (MapSet.new())
Panel shows crate list
User can then browse crates
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN Library tab with selection WHEN Crate tab clicked THEN selection resets to 0
GIVEN Crate tab THEN crate list shown
GIVEN Crate tab → Library tab THEN library reloads

data_states.with_crates: User with downloaded tracks in a crate
